Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement

Hello Morgan State University Faculty & Staff, In this module, we will review key post-award processes for travel on sponsored projects at Morgan State University. Topics include processing travel request forms, requesting reimbursement of travel-related expenses, guidelines for group travel, and more. Please note that the processes detailed in this module are specific to grant-funded activities. Some of the information may also be relevant to state-funded budget actions; however, policy and procedural differences may apply. Review the Travel Office website for further clarification. We strive to continuously review these lessons to provide up-to-date guidance on Morgan’s sponsored project processes. For questions related to the activities covered in this module that are not addressed in the module content, please contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator: Mr. Ryan Mobley, CRA, CFRA, CPRA Email: ryan.mobley@morgan.edu Phone: 443-885-4771 Thank you, ORA Training Team

Self-paced ORA eTraining module. Source: https://share.articulate.com/IrsPFmh4W57M3hmXtCUO2

This module has 8 lessons, each a separate knowledge base entry:
1. Things to Know: Prior to Travel Request
2. Booking a Flight or Train Ticket
3. Group Travel Guidance
4. Additional Travel Rules
5. Travel Request Form (TL Form) Guidance
6. Travel Reimbursement Form (GAD Form X-5)
7. Travel Processing Knowledge Review
8. Message from ORA
